maintenance_orders.description: Post-flight inspection of Cylinder #2 Head Assembly following an in-flight cylinder 2 cht overheat event.
Post-flight inspection of Dry-Sump Lubrication Circuit following an in-flight oil pressure loss event.
Post-flight inspection of Fuel Injection System & Rails following an in-flight fuel injector 1 clog event.

in_flight_directives: Enrich fuel trim +12%, throttle back 15%, descend into denser cooling air.
Throttle back to 4,200 RPM, initiate precautionary landing.
Switch to Lane B ECU backup map, activate auxiliary boost pump.
